class.name: FmodAudioEffectCapture
class.brief_description: Captures audio output to an internal ring buffer for audio visualization, recording, or analysis.

method.name: set_buffer_length
method.description: Sets [member buffer_length] and clears queued audio. The frame counters are preserved.

method.name: can_get_buffer
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when at least [param frames] complete audio frames are queued. Zero returns [code]true[/code]; a negative count returns [code]false[/code]. Availability may change before another call reads the data.

method.name: clear_buffer
method.description: Discards all queued frames and resets [method get_pushed_frames] and [method get_discarded_frames] to zero.

method.name: get_buffer
method.description: Removes and returns up to [param frames] queued stereo frames as a [PackedVector2Array]. Each [Vector2] stores left and right samples in [code]x[/code] and [code]y[/code]. If fewer frames are available, the returned array is shorter. Returns an empty array for a nonpositive count or an empty buffer. Reading does not reset either counter.

method.name: get_discarded_frames
method.description: Returns the number of incoming frames dropped because the buffer was full. The unread frames already in the queue are preserved. Reading does not reset this counter; [method clear_buffer] and detaching the effect reset it.

method.name: get_frames_available
method.description: Returns the number of complete stereo frames currently queued. This is the number of [Vector2] elements that can be read, rather than the number of individual channel samples.

method.name: get_pushed_frames
method.description: Returns the number of frames submitted by the audio callback, including frames that were discarded. Reading does not reset this counter; [method clear_buffer] and detaching the effect reset it.

members.member: Requested buffer length in seconds. It must be finite and positive. Capacity uses the current implementation's 48,000-frames-per-second sizing policy, clamped to 512 through 480,000 frames. Changing it clears queued audio while preserving the frame counters.
